title: The Reading Room Seance
intro: A round table, thirteen chairs and a single planchette that moves on its own. The chest beneath the table will only open for someone who has spoken to the dead.

objects.label: Empty Chair
objects.reward_text: The chair turns slowly towards you. It is not empty.

a_board: Start with the clue that rules out the most positions, such as a figure at an end.
Work out which figures are certainly NOT next to each other, then try the possible arrangements.
From the left, the order begins: Butler, Heir.
The full row from the left is: Butler, Heir, Cook, Doctor, Duke. The answer is the Doctor. The vault's character number 1 is X.
b_ball: There are 8 stones, so the number of ways to pick any pair is 8 x 7 / 2 = 28.
Count the pairs that give the wanted outcome, then divide by the total number of pairs.
The probability is 13/28. The vault's character number 2 is 4.
c_curtain: Find P and Q in your clue notes first.
Divide 28 by 7: it goes in 4 times.
The remainder is 0. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are R and P.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Spirit Board, Crystal Ball, Velvet Curtain.
